name: cv-ats-pipeline-monorepo
description: Scalable Applicant Tracking System with AI CV parsing, skill normalization, and job-fit scoring

scripts.dev:local: concurrently --restart-tries 10 --restart-delay 1000 -n "AI,API,WORKER,WEB" -c "magenta,blue,yellow,cyan" "npm run dev:ai" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.stop: fuser -k 3000/tcp 3001/tcp 8000/tcp 2>/dev/null || true; pkill -f 'next dev|tsc-watch|uvicorn|node dist/index.js|standalone.js' 2>/dev/null || true
